map.计算规则（劳动合同法第47条）：: Calculation rule (Article 47 of the Labor Contract Law):
map.每满一年支付一个月工资；六个月以上不满一年按一年算；不满六个月支付半个月工资。: One month's wage for each full year; six months or more but under a year counts as a year; under six months pays half a month's wage.
map.月工资高于当地上年度职工月平均工资3倍的，按3倍封顶，补偿年限最高不超过12年。: Where the monthly wage exceeds three times the local average monthly wage of the previous year, it is capped at three times that amount and the compensable years are limited to 12.
map.加班费计算规则（劳动法第44条）：: Overtime rules (Article 44 of the Labor Law):
map.工作日延长工作时间：支付不低于工资的 150%；: Extended hours on a working day: not less than 150% of the wage;
map.休息日安排工作又不能安排补休：支付不低于工资的 200%；: Work on a rest day with no compensatory rest given: not less than 200% of the wage;
map.法定休假日安排工作：支付不低于工资的 300%。: Work on a statutory holiday: not less than 300% of the wage.
map.根据最高人民法院规定，民间借贷利率司法保护上限为一年期 LPR 的 4 倍（当前: Under the rules of the Supreme People's Court, the judicial protection ceiling for private lending rates is four times the one-year LPR, currently about 14.6%; the excess is not protected by law. The LPR is adjusted periodically, so follow the latest published figure.

map.根据《民法典》第585条，约定的违约金低于造成的损失的，可请求法院予以增加；过分: Under Article 585 of the Civil Code, where agreed damages are below the loss caused, a court may be asked to increase them, and where they far exceed the loss, generally by more than 30%, a court may be asked to reduce them. The usual reference is that they should not exceed actual loss by more than 30%.

map.居民个人取得全年一次性奖金，符合规定的，在2027年12月31日前可选择不并入当: A resident individual who receives an annual one-off bonus may, before 2027-12-31, choose not to merge it into the year's comprehensive income and instead be taxed on it separately. The bonus is divided by 12 and the monthly average fixes the rate and the quick deduction; tax payable = bonus × rate − quick deduction.
